payload.comment_body:
## Build Update

Delivered the committed cross-platform Faktorial make contract. The final delta contains only Makefile, make.cmd, Pages workflow alignment, and README guidance; a committed runtime result byproduct was removed in hygiene commit 775509b.

Static evidence: `make -n quality` expands typecheck, test, then build in fail-fast order; Windows missing-worktree and unsupported-target guards emit actionable guidance; `git diff --check main...HEAD` passes. Canonical typecheck, tests, and build were not run locally, per build-stage policy, and are requested through Faktorial `run-quality`.

Runtime notes: none were supplied, so none applied.

verification.reason: The committed adapter, CI, and documentation capability is ready for the repository-owned canonical gate; static source and adapter-shape checks are clean.
verification.handoff: If the quality gate fails, preserve the task boundary: repair only the adapters, Pages workflow, or README when the failure is attributable to this change. The current head is 775509b after removing a leaked runtime result artifact.

pull_request_description.delivered_outcome: A cross-platform repository-owned build and test contract is available for Faktorial, contributors, and Pages CI.
pull_request_description.implementation_approach: Added aligned Makefile and make.cmd targets for worktree preparation, typechecking, tests, production builds, and the composed quality gate. Pages CI now calls the canonical gate, and README documents the commands.
pull_request_description.solution_rationale: One shared contract prevents setup and verification behavior from diverging across Windows, portable local environments, Faktorial worktrees, and CI while retaining the existing npm scripts as the execution primitives.
pull_request_description.tradeoffs_and_alternatives: The adapters intentionally remain thin wrappers around deterministic npm ci and existing npm scripts. No dependency upgrades, application changes, or replacement build tooling were introduced.
pull_request_description.architectural_decisions:
The repository now treats the make adapters as the process boundary for quality verification.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Contributors and Faktorial] --> B[Makefile or make.cmd]
    B --> C[typecheck]
    C --> D[test]
    D --> E[build]
    B --> F[Pages CI]
```
pull_request_description.verification: Static checks passed: GNU Make dry-run preserves typecheck → test → build order, Windows guard paths provide actionable errors, and git diff --check is clean. Faktorial-owned run-quality verification is requested for the canonical typecheck, test, and build gate.
